target.identity_check: demo XEX hash and target identity match the qualified expected constants; no retail/Xenia evidence used

architecture.spawn: subprocess.Popen with shell=false, close_fds=true, pass_fds containing only the child fd
architecture.argv: server-configured executable plus fixed --emu-agent-ipc-fd <fd>; no protocol-supplied command or path
architecture.token: unguessable 32-byte token in Python transport; C++ validates lowercase hexadecimal token up to 64 characters
architecture.framing: 4-byte big-endian length prefix plus canonical JSON object; max frame 65536 bytes; duplicate/non-canonical keys rejected
architecture.ownership: one owned child and one private socket per transport; close is idempotent and closes/reaps owned resources
architecture.cpp_mode: --emu-agent-ipc-fd enters C++ run_emu_agent_ipc and owns a DemoSession on the passed fd

backend_states.initial_unavailable: configured binary absent or backend not attached at session boot; receipt remains backend_unavailable
backend_states.transport_failed: owned transport was attached then failed/disconnected; session is poisoned, subsequent observe/step/run_until fail closed
backend_states.replay: boot a separate owned session from an immutable receipt; any replay failure rolls back the new session and owned transport

protocol_boundary.qualification: transport presence is not PAL qualification; available observations remain forbidden because the allowlist is empty

validation.py_compile: pass for transport.py, server.py, ac6_fsm.py and transport/FSM tests

limits.note: IPC and C++ DemoSession tests use controlled fixtures/headless demo code; they do not promote PAL gameplay or mission support.

integrity.hash_definition: receipt SHA-256 is over canonical JSON with integrity.receipt_sha256 replaced by null
